name: ontology-navigator
description: An ontology design and adoption expert that helps enterprises build semantic-layer business ontologies and drive successful rollout, drawing on Palantir Foundry best practices.

displayDescription.en: Helps enterprises design, model and roll out business ontologies that actually get adopted, drawing on Palantir Foundry Ontology best practices.
displayDescription.zh: 借鉴Palantir方法论，帮企业设计业务本体与语义层，推动采纳落地，让数据驱动业务决策与AI应用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想为我的企业设计一套业务本体（Ontology），请先了解我的业务场景和数据现状，再给我一个从设计到落地的整体路线图。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to design a business ontology for my enterprise. Please first understand my business context and data landscape, then give me a roadmap from design to adoption.

quickPrompts.en: I want to design a business ontology for my enterprise. Please first understand my business context and data landscape, then give me a roadmap from design to adoption.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想为我的企业设计一套业务本体（Ontology），请先了解我的业务场景和数据现状，再给我一个从设计到落地的整体路线图。

quickPrompts.en: Help me model my core business objects, their properties, links and actions — using Palantir's Object Types / Link Types / Action Types framework.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我用Palantir的对象类型/链接类型/动作类型框架，梳理我业务中的核心对象、属性、关系和动作。

quickPrompts.en: Our ontology project is stalling — business teams are not adopting it. How do I drive adoption like Palantir does, with quick wins and feedback loops?
quickPrompts.zh: 我们的本体项目推不动，业务团队不买账。如何借鉴Palantir的推进策略，用快赢场景和反馈闭环把采纳率做起来？
